review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Born out of B.TECH—Egypt's leading electronics and appliances retailer with over 27 years of experience in offering buy now, pay later solutions—mylo brings a legacy of trust and innovation to the fintech space. Responsibilities implement, and manage cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP) Automate provisioning, scaling, and maintenance using IaC tools (Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation) Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines with integrated testing, security scans, and quality gates Set up proactive alerting, conduct capacity planning, load testing, and cost optimization Lead incident response, perform root cause analysis, and document runbooks and post-mortems Promote DevOps culture, shift-left testing, and continuous improvement Requirements Bachelor's in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent experience 2+ years in DevOps, SRE, or Cloud Engineering roles with production-grade infrastructure
